items.question: Does {{brand.name}} book courts?
items.answer: No. You bring the courts, at your venue or one you hire. {{brand.name}} runs the session on them: bookings, levels, rotations, court time and standings.

items.question: Which sports does it work for?
items.answer: Pickleball, padel, badminton and tennis doubles, or anything played in pairs on courts. You set the number of courts and the round length.

items.question: What if the levels are uneven?
items.answer: You see each player’s level before the session, and can move anyone between rounds. Court time is counted for every player.

items.question: What happens with late arrivals?
items.answer: Check them in at the door. They join the next round.

items.question: Do players need an app?
items.answer: No. Players book, check in and see their next court in their phone’s browser.

items.question: How is this different from a court-booking app?
items.answer: Court-booking apps help players book courts and find games. {{brand.name}} helps you run a session for a group: levels, rotations, court time and standings. Many hosts book the courts in one place and run the session on {{brand.name}}.
